title: Update the locate database
summary: The `locate` command uses a database that is updated periodically. If you cannot find a file you just created, you can manually update this database to include recent changes.

steps.explain: Recompute the locate database so it includes recently added files. This requires administrator privileges.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to undo this update. The database will be automatically recomputed by the system periodically.

warnings: This command requires administrator privileges and may take some time to complete.
